# JNU New Delhi: overview, contacts, schools and student offices

Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Mehrauli Road, JNU Ring Rd, New Delhi, Delhi 110067. Website: https://www.jnu.ac.in. The homepage says JNU is 'ranked #2 by NIRF 2025' (university category) and 'NAAC Accredited JNU A++ grade'.

## Main contacts

- PABX: +91-11-26742575, 26742676, 26741557 · Fax: +91-11-26741586
- Vice Chancellor: +91-11-26704001, 26741500; vc@mail.jnu.ac.in

- Public Relations: +91-11-26704017/4046, 26742601; pro@mail.jnu.ac.in

## Schools

Centres: https://www.jnu.ac.in/?tab=schools-centres

title: JNU admissions 2026-27: routes, prospectuses and contacts
content:
# JNU admissions 2026-27: routes, prospectuses and contacts

Admissions listing: https://www.jnu.ac.in/index.php/admissions

## 2026-27 e-Prospectuses (eligibility, seats, fees)
- UG and COP: https://www.jnu.ac.in/sites/default/files/admission/e-Prospectus-UG-COP-2026-27.pdf
- PG and ADOP: https://www.jnu.ac.in/sites/default/files/admission/e-Prospectus-PG-ADOP-2026-27.pdf
- DOP: https://www.jnu.ac.in/sites/default/files/admission/eProspectus_DOP2026-27.pdf
- PhD: https://www.jnu.ac.in/sites/default/files/admission/eProspectus_PhD2026-27.pdf
- Admission Policy 2026-27: https://www.jnu.ac.in/sites/default/files/admission/AdmissionPolicy2026-27.pdf
- International students: https://www.jnu.ac.in/Admission/International

## Routes
- **UG and COP:** through **CUET (UG)** (named in the 2025-26 notices; confirm in the 2026-27 prospectus). A last-and-final call for vacant UG seats was issued for 2026-27.
- **PG and ADOP:** through **CUET (PG)** (named in the 2025-26 notices; confirm in the 2026-27 prospectus).
- **MBA:** online registration closed on **May 15, 2026**.
- **PhD 2026-27:** through **NET/JRF/GATE**, with a separate schedule and viva-voce notice.
- **M.Sc Biotechnology and M.Sc Computational and Integrative Sciences:** through **GAT-B**.
- **Foreign nationals (in absentia):** PhD last date 09.10.2026; UG/PG last date 30.4.2026, extended to 11.5.2026.

## Admission contacts
- Deputy Registrar (Admission): +91-11-26704047, 26704048, 26742617; admission@mail.jnu.ac.in
- Director (Admission): +91-11-26704012, 26742616; director_admissions@mail.jnu.ac.in

# JNU academic calendar 2026-27 and student support contacts

Also posted: the notification on commencement of classes for newly admitted PG students (2026-27), and a notice extending the add/drop date for newly admitted students in the Monsoon Semester 2026.
